description: This file defines the 'Chart' class within the MigraDoc library, which represents different types of charts in a document object model. It includes properties for chart types, axes, series collections, various areas (header, footer, etc.), and serialization and cloning methods.

classes.name: Chart
classes.description: Represents a chart with various configurable properties like axes, series, and visual areas, supporting cloning, serialization, and visitor patterns.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Chart instance.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Implements deep copying of nested chart components.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the chart to a specified format.

methods.name: CheckAxis
methods.description: Returns the axis type ('xaxis', 'yaxis', 'zaxis') matching the provided axis.

methods.name: CheckTextArea
methods.description: Determines the text area type ('headerarea', 'footerarea', etc.) matching the provided TextArea.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the current Chart object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of all nested Chart values and components.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Chart object to a specified serializer.

methods.name: CheckAxis
methods.description: Checks the type of a given axis (X, Y, Z) and returns its string identifier.

methods.name: CheckTextArea
methods.description: Checks the type of a given text area (Header, Footer, etc.) and returns its string identifier.
